mentions.name: Repple
mentions.description: A spaced repetition and incremental reading app with a PDF library. It combines flashcards with a reader and note-taking view, includes a few quality-of-life AI features, and exposes a REST API for the flashcard side. It aims for a cleaner UX than Anki and to fill the gap left by the discontinued Polar Bookshelf.
mentions.problem: The author loved Anki for 10+ years but wanted a cleaner UX and a reader view; the Anki ownership change and the demise of Polar Bookshelf motivated building a replacement.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Repple (https://repple.sh)! It's a modern spaced repetition x incremental reading/PDF library app with a few (tasteful!) QOL AI features.

mentions.name: Repple
mentions.description: A free flashcard app with spaced repetition scheduling plus AI features: automatic image generation for image fields, optional rephrasing of wording on each review to avoid pattern matching, and semantic search. Includes tab-autocomplete for text fields, a PDF library with incremental reading, orphan card detection for poorly connected knowledge, and a REST API exposing decks, cards, and reviews so others can build on top of it.
mentions.problem: A long-time Anki user wanted a flashcard tool with a cleaner UI that is easier to experiment with; the recent Anki ownership change prompted building an alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Repple (https://repple.sh), a free flashcard app with spaced repetition scheduling and some (tasteful imo) AI additions.
